mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently a warm 83 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park, feeling like 85. Keep an eye on the sky tonight under the waxing crescent moon, as the International Space Station will make a clear, six-minute appearance starting at 9:31 PM, rising in the northwest.

In city news, Verona is reminding apartment residents that composting is still possible through private services or by utilizing the local Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, official election notices are now posted for the upcoming Partisan Primary on August 11th and the General Election on November 3rd.

We have a wonderful lineup of local activities starting July 19th, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie, and the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Later in the week, look out for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In police news, on Friday, July 10th, the Verona Police K9 unit was active during traffic stops, with K9 Drea successfully alerting officers to drugs in two separate incidents, resulting in arrests and citations for drug possession.

To wrap up today's update, the Culver's flavor of the day is the rich and delicious Turtle. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by. If you cannot make it, tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Crunch.
